about_the_game:
This is a small indie game, created with passion despite the many challenges along the way. It may not have the polish and grandeur of big productions, but I hope it can bring you a moment of lighthearted joy. Ruarua.ru will continue to be updated and improved, striving to offer all explorers a better experience.

A long-term farming project that always accompanies you...

Ruarua.ru is a long-term farming project that that always accompanies you, It is a simple farming game that can be played anytime and anywhere when you have free time. Here, you can not only make many friends, communicate and play together, but also slowly accumulate resources through playing, and gain a full sense of accomplishment.

In Ruarua.ru, you take on the role of an Explorer, embarking on an adventurous journey filled with battles against monsters and the collection of loot cards. You can choose Free Mode, where you actively hunt down monsters to initiate combat, or opt for Explore Mode, where you wait for the next wave of monsters and respond strategically. Of course, there are many other ways to obtain cards as well!

Each card has its own unique function — some generate a steady flow of resources, while others enhance your combat skills and performance. As you gather more cards, you can combine lower-tier cards into more powerful higher-tier ones, and equip them to strengthen your abilities. As you grow stronger, you'll gradually unlock access to more dangerous and mysterious places, encounter a variety of NPCs, and uncover more stories and challenges waiting to be revealed.

Explorers, let’s set off on this journey together!

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or higher
